#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_set>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    const long long limit = 100000000000LL;
    long long a[40];
    a[0] = 1LL;
    long long temp = 1LL;
    int n = 1;

    while (n < 16) {
        temp *= w;
        a[n] = temp;
        if (temp > limit) break;
        n++;
    }

    unordered_set<long long> balances;
    balances.insert(0LL);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        unordered_set<long long> next;
        for (long long v : balances) {
            next.insert(v);
            next.insert(v + a[i]);
            next.insert(v - a[i]);
        }
        balances = move(next);
    }

    if (balances.find(m) != balances.end()) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
